title: AutoL2S: Auto Long-Short Reasoning for Efficient Large Language Models
authors_zh: Feng Luo；Yu-Neng Chuang；Guanchu Wang；Hoang Anh Duy Le；Shaochen Zhong；Hongyi Liu；Jiayi Yuan；Yang Sui；Vladimir Braverman；Vipin Chaudhary；Xia Hu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A long-to-short reasoning-distillation recipe that attempts to retain correct concise traces.
AutoL2S 将长推理与短推理配对，保留正确且更短的答案，并以长度控制标记训练可在长短推理间切换的模型。
why: It is a Track 5 bridge from expensive long rollouts to compact trainable traces, but the unreleased pair corpus limits independent audit.
inclusion_reason: It is a Track 5 bridge from expensive long rollouts to compact trainable traces, but the unreleased pair corpus limits independent audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Distilling long reasoning traces can improve a smaller or non-reasoning model, but it can also teach the student to produce long chains for inputs that do not need them. Simply truncating outputs or adding a universal length penalty risks removing necessary intermediate reasoning on harder questions. AutoL2S asks how to construct supervision that teaches both concise and extended solutions and lets the model select between them per instance.

The paper's data object is a paired long-short reasoning record. Starting from a Bespoke-Stratos-17k question and reference answer, a strong teacher supplies a correct long chain, a short teacher generates several candidate short chains, answer correctness filters them, and the shortest correct candidate is retained. The record also contains a routing annotation indicating that a short path exists, trigger tokens delimiting the long and short modes, and the final answer. Questions without a verified short path keep only the long trace.

This object is used first for supervised distillation and then to induce long/short online rollouts for a GRPO-style refinement stage. The official code repository includes curation and training scripts, and the official Hugging Face repository releases an Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5-7B-based model. A fully versioned paired raw-trace dataset, rejected candidates, correctness evidence, teacher generations, and split manifest were not confirmed as released, so the model checkpoint is not a substitute for data lineage.

蒸馏长推理 trace 可以增强较小或非推理模型，但也可能让 student 对无需长思考的输入持续生成冗长 chain。简单截断输出或统一加入长度惩罚，则可能删除困难问题所需的中间推理。AutoL2S 研究如何构造同时包含简短与扩展解答的监督，并让模型按实例选择二者。

论文的数据对象是 paired long-short reasoning record。以 Bespoke-Stratos-17k 的问题和 reference answer 为起点，强 teacher 生成正确 long chain，short teacher 生成多个 short-chain candidate，再按答案正确性过滤并保留最短正确候选。记录还包含表示短路径存在的 routing annotation、区分长短模式的 trigger token 与 final answer。没有通过验证的短路径时，只保留 long trace。

该对象先用于 supervised distillation，再用于诱导 long/short online rollout，并进入 GRPO-style refinement。官方代码仓库提供 curation 与训练脚本，官方 Hugging Face repository 发布基于 Qwen2.5-7B、Apache-2.0 的模型。尚未确认发布完整版本化 paired raw-trace dataset、被拒候选、正确性证据、teacher generation 与 split manifest，因此 model checkpoint 不能替代 data lineage。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AutoL2S uses two stages. In SFT, DeepSeek-R1 supplies long correct reasoning and Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct supplies k short candidates. Among candidates whose extracted answer matches the reference, the shortest is selected. When both modes exist, the training sequence marks the item with an EASY routing token and includes long and short reasoning; otherwise it uses the long path only. At inference, the SFT model emits either the long-mode trigger or the EASY decision, after which constrained decoding injects the short-mode trigger.

The second stage samples these automatically routed rollouts from the SFT policy and applies a clipped GRPO-style objective. Utility is binary final-answer correctness; positive and negative advantages reinforce correct rollouts and discourage incorrect ones, while the policy ratio is clipped with epsilon 0.2 to keep the new distribution near the SFT model. There is no explicit token-length reward in this objective: shorter behavior is inherited from the paired supervision and routing decision.

The feedback contract therefore has two layers: programmatic answer correctness selects the shortest valid short trace during construction, and answer-level binary utility supervises routed rollouts during refinement. The track fit is long-to-short or distill-from-search data, where the paired traces, rejected short candidates, routing token, and rollout mode must remain visible rather than collapsing everything into a final checkpoint.

AutoL2S 分两阶段。SFT 阶段由 DeepSeek-R1 提供正确长推理，Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 生成 k 个短候选；在抽取答案与 reference 匹配的候选中，保留最短者。当长短两种模式都存在时，训练序列用 EASY routing token 标记该样本并同时包含长短推理；否则只使用长路径。推理时，SFT 模型先生成 long-mode trigger 或 EASY 决策，若选择短模式，再由 constrained decoding 注入 short-mode trigger。

第二阶段从 SFT policy 采样这些自动路由的 rollout，并使用 clipped GRPO-style objective。Utility 是 binary final-answer correctness；正负 advantage 强化正确 rollout、抑制错误 rollout，policy ratio 以 epsilon 0.2 截断，使新分布保持接近 SFT 模型。该 objective 没有显式 token-length reward；短输出行为来自 paired supervision 与路由决策。

反馈契约因此有两层：构造阶段用 programmatic answer correctness 选择最短有效 short trace，refinement 阶段用 answer-level binary utility 监督路由 rollout。它适合本 track 的 long-to-short 或 distill-from-search data；paired trace、被拒短候选、routing token 与 rollout mode 都应可见，不能只剩 final checkpoint。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source questions come from Bespoke-Stratos-17k, described as 17,000 question, long-reasoning, and answer examples. The paper uses DeepSeek-R1 as the long-reasoning teacher and Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct as the short teacher. Rejection sizes 0, 4, and 8 are studied, with k=8 used as the default paper setting; the repository README describes generating four or eight short attempts. Correct candidates are ranked by token length, and duplicate question-answer pairs carrying both long and easy routing annotations are deduplicated in favor of the easy-marked pair. Exact tie handling, answer parser, failed-generation policy, and final pair count are not disclosed clearly enough to reconstruct the corpus from the paper alone.

SFT trains Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct bases on the constructed sequences. The repository reports full-parameter training, batch size 32, three epochs, and learning rate 1e-5; the paper specifies AdamW, temperature 0.7, four A100 80GB GPUs for 7B and two for 3B. The post-training stage samples automatically routed long/short rollouts and optimizes binary correctness with the clipped objective. Evaluation covers MATH500, GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, OlympiadBench-Math, AIME, and MMLU-Pro, using output accuracy and generated-token length.

The official GitHub repository provides data-curation scripts, SFT, post-training, inference, and evaluation code, but its visible root has no dataset release or explicit license file. The official Hugging Face model page releases AutoL2S-7B weights, configuration, and inference examples under Apache-2.0 and notes that the paper's EASY token is implemented as specialLong. For reproducibility, a pinned code/model revision, raw long/short pairs, all rejected attempts, prompt templates, exact split, seeds, teacher revisions, correctness logs, and the mapping between paper notation and implementation token names still need verification.

源问题来自 Bespoke-Stratos-17k，论文将其描述为 17,000 条问题、长推理和答案样本。长推理 teacher 为 DeepSeek-R1，短推理 teacher 为 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct。论文研究 rejection size 0、4、8，并以 k=8 作为默认设置；仓库 README 描述生成四次或八次短答案。在正确候选中按 token length 排序；若同一 question-answer pair 同时带 long 与 easy routing annotation，则去重并保留 easy 标记版本。Exact tie handling、answer parser、失败生成处理与最终 pair 数披露不足，无法仅凭论文重建 corpus。

SFT 在构造序列上训练 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。仓库报告 full-parameter training、batch size 32、三个 epoch、learning rate 1e-5；论文指定 AdamW、temperature 0.7，7B 使用四张 A100 80GB，3B 使用两张。Post-training 阶段采样自动路由的 long/short rollout，并用 clipped objective 优化 binary correctness。评测覆盖 MATH500、GPQA-Diamond、GSM8K、OlympiadBench-Math、AIME 与 MMLU-Pro，指标为输出准确率和生成 token length。

官方 GitHub 仓库提供 data-curation、SFT、post-training、inference 与 evaluation 代码，但可见根目录没有 dataset release 或明确 license file。官方 Hugging Face model page 以 Apache-2.0 发布 AutoL2S-7B 权重、配置和推理示例，并说明论文 EASY token 在实现中名为 specialLong。完整复现仍需固定 code/model revision，并核对 raw long/short pair、全部被拒 attempt、prompt template、精确 split、seed、teacher revision、正确性日志，以及论文记号与实现 token 名称的映射。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Table 1 reports AutoL2S at average accuracy 0.573 and average length 2,103 tokens, versus 0.590 and 7,430 for Bespoke-Stratos-7B. This is a 71.7% average length reduction with a 1.7-point absolute average accuracy decrease. For the 3B setup, AutoL2S reports 0.415 and 4,803 tokens versus 0.413 and 10,219 for Bespoke-Stratos-3B. Per-benchmark effects are not uniform: some tasks improve, while AIME24 and others lose accuracy.

Ablations compare SFT-only, force-short, force-long, rejection sizes 0/4/8, and alternative annotation orders. They support the claim that adaptive routing differs from globally forcing one mode and that rejection sampling affects the accuracy-length trade-off. The paper also reports additional teacher and repeated-run analyses.

These measurements show a model-level efficiency trade-off under the chosen decoding setup; they do not establish that the shortest correct trace is semantically complete or that the paired training data are high quality. The ACL Anthology record, official code, and official model weights verify the paper and implementation path, but no complete paired corpus or per-example selection evidence was confirmed as public.

对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，表 1 报告 AutoL2S 的平均准确率为 0.573、平均长度为 2,103 token，而 Bespoke-Stratos-7B 为 0.590 和 7,430；即平均长度减少 71.7%，平均准确率绝对下降 1.7 点。3B 设置中，AutoL2S 为 0.415 和 4,803 token，Bespoke-Stratos-3B 为 0.413 和 10,219。逐 benchmark 效果并不一致：部分任务提高，AIME24 等任务则有准确率下降。

消融比较 SFT-only、force-short、force-long、rejection size 0/4/8 及不同 annotation order，支持 adaptive routing 不等同于全局强制一种模式，也表明 rejection sampling 会改变 accuracy-length trade-off。论文还报告额外 teacher 与重复运行分析。

这些测量说明所选解码设置下的 model-level efficiency trade-off，不能证明 shortest correct trace 在语义上完整，也不能证明 paired training data 高质量。ACL Anthology 条目、官方代码和官方模型权重验证了论文与实现路径，但未确认公开完整 paired corpus 或逐样本选择证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Long-CoT distillation usually transfers one verbose teacher trace, while length-control approaches may prune, set a token budget, or add an explicit length reward. AutoL2S instead constructs both long and shortest-correct short supervision for the same question, trains a generated routing token, and then refines the induced modes with answer-level rollouts while keeping the policy close to SFT. This makes reasoning length an instance-level routing decision rather than one global target.

The paper does not introduce distillation, rejection sampling, shortest-correct filtering, special tokens, GRPO-style clipping, or binary correctness individually. Its specific contribution is their two-stage composition and the use of paired long-short order to teach routing without an explicit length term in the refinement reward.

For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, the direction signal is that expensive teacher traces can be transformed into compact trainable traces only if pair lineage and rejection evidence remain available. The reported accuracy-length curves are a method-quality signal, not proof of corpus quality. Reuse must verify teacher provenance, answer checking, candidate multiplicity, mode annotation, rejected traces, and whether compression removed necessary reasoning.

Long-CoT 蒸馏通常只转移一条冗长的教师轨迹，而长度控制方法可能采用剪枝、设定 token 预算或加入显式长度奖励。AutoL2S 为同一问题同时构造长轨迹监督与“最短且正确”的短轨迹监督，训练模型生成路由 token，再以基于答案正确性的 rollout 优化两种模式，并让策略保持接近 SFT。由此，推理长度成为逐样本的路由决策，而不是单一全局目标。

论文并未分别首创蒸馏、拒绝采样、最短正确轨迹筛选、特殊 token、GRPO 式裁剪或二元正确性反馈。其特定贡献是把这些组件组成两阶段流程，并用成对的长短轨迹顺序教会模型路由，而不在优化奖励中加入显式长度项。

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，方向信号是：只有保留配对沿袭关系与拒绝证据，昂贵的教师轨迹才能被可靠转换为紧凑的可训练轨迹。论文的准确率—长度曲线是方法表现信号，不是语料质量证明。复用时必须核验教师来源、答案检查、候选数量、模式标注、被拒轨迹，以及压缩是否删除必要推理。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper notes dependence on costly, high-quality paired long/short annotations, a coarse binary long-versus-short decision, and efficiency results tied to autoregressive decoding. Final-answer correctness is the construction verifier; it does not certify intermediate validity, and choosing the shortest correct sample can favor lucky or underspecified rationales. Teacher errors and stylistic artifacts can propagate into both modes.

The full paired dataset, rejected samples, exact counts, ties, data license, splits, decontamination, and correctness logs were not confirmed as released. The code repository has one visible commit and no root license file, while only the model repository declares Apache-2.0. Paper notation and implementation naming for the EASY routing token differ and require care. Results cover two base sizes and mostly math/reasoning benchmarks; accuracy losses on some tasks show that compression is not uniformly safe. Model weights do not resolve these data-audit gaps.

论文指出，该方法依赖成本较高的高质量 long/short paired annotation，长短二分较粗，并且效率结果绑定自回归解码。构造 verifier 只是 final-answer correctness；它不能证明中间步骤有效，而选择 shortest correct sample 可能偏向碰巧答对或论证不足的 rationale。Teacher 错误与风格 artifact 也会传播到两种模式。

完整 paired dataset、被拒样本、精确数量、tie、data license、split、去污染与正确性日志未确认为发布。代码仓库可见历史只有一个 commit，根目录未显示 license file；只有 model repository 声明 Apache-2.0。论文 EASY routing token 与实现命名不同，复现时需谨慎。结果覆盖两个 base size，且以数学/推理 benchmark 为主；部分任务准确率下降说明压缩并非普遍安全。Model weights 无法弥补这些 data-audit gap。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For this track, AutoL2S suggests a reusable long-to-short record with prompt/source ID, reference answer, long teacher and revision, long trace and correctness result, all k short candidates, answer extraction, rejection reasons, token lengths, chosen shortest trace, tie rule, routing annotation, final SFT sequence, rollout mode, binary utility, and post-training update. Keeping rejected candidates is important because the selected short trace alone hides search cost and verifier bias.

Such records can support reasoning compression, adaptive SFT, distillation, and audits of when short traces fail. They also let curators separate teacher-data effects from the routing token and GRPO-style optimizer. The released code and 7B checkpoint are useful for implementation study, but independent data reuse requires reconstructing or releasing the paired corpus and its provenance.

对本 track，AutoL2S 提示一种可复用的长转短记录：问题及来源 ID、参考答案、长轨迹教师模型及版本、长轨迹及其正确性结果、全部 k 个短轨迹候选、答案抽取结果、拒绝原因、token 长度、选中的最短轨迹、平局规则、路由标注、最终 SFT 序列、rollout 模式、二元效用和后训练更新。保存被拒候选很重要，因为只看选中的短轨迹会隐藏搜索成本和 verifier 偏差。

这些记录可支持推理压缩、自适应 SFT、蒸馏和短轨迹失败条件审计，也能把教师数据效应与路由 token、GRPO 式优化器分开。已发布代码和 7B checkpoint 适合实现研究，但独立数据复用仍需重建或发布成对语料及其来源沿袭信息。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• AutoL2S pairs a DeepSeek-R1 long trace with the shortest correct Qwen2.5-Math-7B short candidate for each eligible question.
  • Rejection size k=8 is the paper's default; rejected candidates and the final pair corpus were not confirmed as released.
  • SFT learns an EASY routing decision, and a clipped GRPO-style stage reinforces answer-correct routed rollouts without an explicit length reward.
  • The 7B result reports 71.7% shorter average output with a 1.7-point average accuracy drop relative to Bespoke-Stratos-7B.
  • Official code and Apache-2.0 model weights exist, but model release is not evidence of complete training-data lineage.
  • Paper and implementation token names differ, so exact routing semantics require a pinned revision.

• AutoL2S 为每个合格问题配对 DeepSeek-R1 long trace 与 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 shortest correct short candidate。
  • 论文默认 rejection size k=8；被拒候选和最终 pair corpus 未确认为发布。
  • SFT 学习 EASY routing decision，clipped GRPO-style 阶段在无显式 length reward 下强化答案正确的路由 rollout。
  • 7B 结果相对 Bespoke-Stratos-7B 报告平均输出缩短 71.7%，平均准确率下降 1.7 点。
  • 官方代码和 Apache-2.0 模型权重已存在，但 model release 不能证明完整 training-data lineage。
  • 论文与实现 token 名称不同，精确 routing semantics 需要固定 revision 核对。
